summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper and its registry. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) class with eleven members; botocore/args.py adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults and lets _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept an absent endpoint config; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 26 tests. Nothing was committed. Verification: test_args.py, test_regions.py, and test_client.py pass (415 tests). A full tests/unit run showed one failure in test_awsrequest.py::test_encodes_unicode_method_line, and stashing my changes shows that file already failing (9 failures) before my edits. I did not get a final full-suite count after my edits. Line lengths were checked by hand; black and isort were not run.
